name: Cicero
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Cicero, IL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Cicero, IL: Christmas in the Park with Santa, a Christmas train and the Bobby Hull Ice Rink opening, plus library Santa photos.
lede: Cicero kicks off Christmas with one big evening in Cicero Community Park, where Santa visits, a Christmas train gives rides and the Bobby Hull Community Ice Rink opens for the winter. December adds Santa photos at the library and a pajama party with Santa at the American Legion post.
celebrates: In Cicero, the Christmas season starts at Christmas in the Park, put on by the Town President, the Board of Trustees and the Department of Special Events at Cicero Community Park, 34th Street and Laramie Avenue. Families meet Santa and take photos, ride the Christmas train, take horse and carriage rides, make crafts, listen to story time and watch the town Christmas tree light up. The same night the Bobby Hull Community Ice Rink opens for skating. The town also runs a Christmas Gift Program for Cicero children up to age 14, and the police department hosts Shop with a Cop.
lastyear: Christmas in the Park was planned for Sunday, November 30, 2025, from 4 to 7 pm, with photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus, Christmas train rides, horse and carriage rides, crafts, story time and the opening of the ice rink. The town's recap the next day described families at the Christmas tree lighting, pictures with Santa, arts and crafts, hot chocolate and the rink opening. On December 6 the Cicero Police Department held its annual Shop with a Cop at the Cicero Walmart, and on December 13 the town's annual Christmas Gifts event filled the PSO Building.
facts: The Bobby Hull Community Ice Rink is named for the NHL Hall of Famer and Chicago Blackhawks legend. It was a gift from the Wirtz Corporation, whose distribution warehouse sits across the street from the park, and it first opened during a Christmas in the Park celebration. At the 2024 lighting, the whole crowd counted down from 10 before the tree lit up. The Special Events director said the town tries to give hats and gloves to every child who comes. Santa told a reporter that night that his favorite cookie is chocolate chip.
trains: Cicero has its own Metra stop. Cicero station on the BNSF line is 7 miles from Chicago Union Station, in fare zone 2, and Metra rebuilt its platforms and shelters in 2010. The CTA Pink Line ends in town at 54th/Cermak, a station that opened in 1912 and was once called the Cicero-Berwyn Terminal. The next stop toward downtown is Cicero, and Pink Line trains run straight to the Loop. For a bigger train day, the Griffin Museum of Science and Industry in Chicago has a giant model railroad, and the Illinois Railway Museum in Union runs a Christmas train.

kidfact: Cicero's outdoor ice rink is named after Bobby Hull, a famous Chicago Blackhawks hockey player. It opens every year on the same night Santa comes to Christmas in the Park.
faq: What is Christmas in the Park in Cicero?

It is the town's yearly holiday kickoff at Cicero Community Park, 34th Street and Laramie Avenue, hosted by the Town President, the Board of Trustees and the Department of Special Events. Families meet Santa and take photos, meet holiday characters, ride the Christmas train, take horse and carriage rides, make crafts and hear story time.
When does the Bobby Hull Ice Rink open?

The Bobby Hull Community Ice Rink opens each winter during Christmas in the Park at Cicero Community Park. The town says the rink gives local children a place to learn to skate without driving far away. In past years a synchronized skating team performed a routine to open the ice.
Does Cicero have a Christmas tree lighting?

Yes. The Cicero Christmas tree is lit at Christmas in the Park in Cicero Community Park. At the 2024 lighting, the Director of Special Events welcomed the crowd and led a countdown from 10, and then families stayed for crafts, horse carriage rides, skating and a visit with Santa.
What is the Cicero Christmas Gift Program?

Each year the Town of Cicero invites residents to register their children, from 1 month through 14 years old, to receive a Christmas gift, one gift per household. Parents register in person at the Cicero Community Center or the PSO Building with an ID, birth certificates and two current utility bills, all showing the same name and address.
Can we get to Cicero by train?

Yes. Metra's BNSF line stops at Cicero station, 7 miles from Chicago Union Station. The CTA Pink Line ends at 54th/Cermak on Cermak Road in Cicero, and its next stop is Cicero station, with trains running to the Loop. The 54th/Cermak station sits between 54th and Laramie Avenues.
